title: Integral geometric fibres of a local regular morphism of strictly local schemes
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a local morphism between Noetherian strictly local schemes, where strictly local means the spectrum of a henselian local ring with separably closed residue field [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Assume that $f$ is regular: it is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and its fibres remain regular after every finite extension of their residue fields [def-weil-regular-scheme, def-pc-scheme-fibre]. For every geometric point $\bar z\to X$ [def-weil-geometric-point], the geometric fibre $Y\times_X\bar z$ is nonempty and integral, that is, reduced and irreducible.

source.place: Expose XVII, Lemma 4.3.2.3, printed pp.284–285. The nonemptiness follows from faithful flatness of a flat local ring map; integrality is the stated lemma.
